problem:
Title: Maximal Ideal WRT Filter Complement is Prime in Distributive Lattice/Lemma 1

Let $\struct {S, \vee, \wedge, \preceq}$ be a [[Definition:Distributive Lattice|distributive lattice]].

Let $F$ be a [[Definition:Filter|filter]] in $L$.

Let $M$ be an [[Definition:Ideal (Order Theory)|ideal]] in $L$ which is [[Definition:Disjoint Sets|disjoint]] from $F$ such that:
:no [[Definition:Ideal (Order Theory)|ideal]] in $L$ larger than $M$ is [[Definition:Disjoint Sets|disjoint]] from $F$.

There do not exist $m$ and $n$ in $M$ such that $m \vee a \in F$ and $n \vee b \in F$.
proof_numbered:
0001 | {{AimForCont}} such exist.
0002 | 
0003 | Since:
0004 | :$m \vee \paren {n \vee b} \ge n \vee b$
0005 | :$n \vee b \in F$
0006 | :$F$ is a [[Definition:Filter|filter]]
0007 | it follows that:
0008 | :$m \vee \paren {n \vee b} \in F$
0009 | 
0010 | Applying associativity yields:
0011 | 
0012 | :$\paren {m \vee n} \vee b \in F$
0013 | 
0014 | By the same argument:
0015 | 
0016 | :$\paren {m \vee n} \vee a \in F$
0017 | 
0018 | By the definition of a [[Definition:Filter|filter]]:
0019 | 
0020 | :$\paren {\paren {m \vee n} \vee b} \wedge \paren {\paren {n \vee m} \vee a} \in F$
0021 | 
0022 | Distributing:
0023 | 
0024 | :$\paren {m \vee n} \wedge \paren {b \vee a} \in F$
0025 | 
0026 | But by assumption:
0027 | :$b \vee a \in M$
0028 | and by the definition of an [[Definition:Ideal (Order Theory)|ideal]]:
0029 | :$m \vee n \in M$
0030 | 
0031 | so again by the definition of an [[Definition:Ideal (Order Theory)|ideal]]:
0032 | 
0033 | :$\paren {m \vee n} \wedge \paren {b \vee a} \in M$
0034 | 
0035 | [[Definition:Contradiction|contradicting]] the supposition that $M$ is disjoint from $F$.
0036 | {{qed}}
0037 |
